SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 1902 Date MAY 6, 1938）

Subject Communication dated 30.4.38 from the Portuguese Consulate-General
concerning Mr. Nicolas Scholl Engberts.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Crawford. J. J.

Enquiries show that Nicolas Herman Scholl-Engberts,
42, reported to be a Russian of Netherlands origin, arrived
in Shanghai in March, 1930. In August of the same year
he registered with the Municipal Police as a candidate for
the post of a police-watchman or bodyguard. Subsequently,
he served as a bodyguard to Mr. Loh Ming Cheng, Compradore,
Dibrell Brothers Inc., 12 The Bund, from 27.4.31 to 12.11.31.
He left this position on his own accord and with a good
testimonial. In February, 1932 he was engaged as a police
watchman by the Pioneer Knitting Mill, 10 Rangoon Road, in
which capacity he worked until 27.7.33 when his services
were dispensed with. During this period he was fined two
days' pay on a charge of absence from duty and assault and
was also warned against drinking. However, on discharge
he was given a good testimonial by the manager of the
Pioneer Knitting Factory. In Summer 1934 he was engaged
in the same capacity by the New Engineering & Shipbuilding
Works, 640 Yangtsepoo Road, but in October of the same
year was replaced by another man at the request of his
employers, who found his services unsatisfactory.

He is not on the list of approved candidates for the
post of police watchmen at present.

Engberts is known to have been employed as a stoker at
the Yangtsepoo Power Station in 1936.

There is nothing in Municipal Police records against
him.

（批：D.B.Q. 5/5）

D.C. (Special Branch)

G. Prokopiev
D. S. I.

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科登记处 编号 S. B. D. 1902 日期 1938年5月6日）

事由：葡萄牙总领事馆于1938年4月30日来函，涉及 Nicolas Scholl Engberts 先生。
由副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报，经 C. Crawford 转呈。J. J.

经查，Nicolas Herman Scholl-Engberts，42岁，据报为荷兰裔俄国人，于1930年3月抵达上海。同年8月，他在工部局警务处登记，申请担任巡捕或保镖职位。随后，他于1931年4月27日至1931年11月12日期间，担任外滩12号迪布雷尔兄弟公司（Dibrell Brothers Inc.）买办罗明成（Loh Ming Cheng，音译）先生的保镖。他是自愿离职的，并获得了良好的推荐信。1932年2月，他被兰开路10号先锋针织厂（Pioneer Knitting Mill）聘为巡捕，在此职位上工作至1933年7月27日，随后被解雇。在此期间，他因缺勤和袭击罪名被罚款两天薪水，并受到关于饮酒的警告。然而，在离职时，先锋针织厂经理给予了他良好的推荐信。1934年夏，他被杨树浦路640号新工程造船厂（New Engineering & Shipbuilding Works）以相同身份聘用，但同年10月，雇主因其服务令人不满意，要求将其替换为另一人。

他目前不在批准的巡捕候选人名单上。

据悉，Engberts 曾于1936年在杨树浦发电厂担任司炉工。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何对他不利的记录。

（批注：D.B.Q. 5/5）

特务科副总监

G. Prokopiev
副督察

CONSUL-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 3852.

SHANGHAI, 16 November 1936.

（批注框内文字：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / S. B. D. 1902 / 17 // 36）

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to Mr. Aiers' letter No. S. B.
D. 1902 of January 30, 1931, concerning the former Netherlands'
subject Nicolas Scholl Engberts and to inform you that about
a week ago I received a visit from his wife Madame Nathalie
Scholl-Engberts, born at Petrograd on May 17th, 1900, holder
of a passport No. 17191, issued to her by the Acting Consul for
the Netherlands at Newchang on February 20, '29, which states no
nationality, but on which a note has been made by the Nether-
lands Legation at Peiping on October 14, 1931 to the effect
that her husband has petitioned Her Majesty, the Queen of the
upon
Netherlands, again to bestow him the Netherlands' nationality.

Mrs. Scholl-Engberts is anxious to get into touch with
her husband once more and has asked my intermediary to obtain
his address.

In the course of the last few years he has been a body-
guard to a Chinese and afterwards a watchman with the Council,
in which latter capacity I understand his services were not
very satisfactory.

It is a long time however since I have heard from him and
it is possible that he has left Shanghai.

Nevertheless I should be grateful if inquiries could be made
as to his present whereabouts.

Mrs. Scholl-Engberts is living at 31 Rue Massenet c/o
Mme. de Voyod.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chinese-Secretary.

Major E. H. Bourne,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

P. A.
Consul ad interim a. i.
（印章：... BRANCH ... 17 NOV ...）

S. &.

（批注框内文字：上海公共租界工部局 / 特务科登记处 / S. B. D. 1902 / 17 // 36）

先生，

谨此提及 Aiers 先生于1931年1月30日发出的第 S. B. D. 1902 号信函，该函涉及前荷兰籍民 Nicolas Scholl Engberts，并通知您，约一周前，他的妻子 Nathalie Scholl-Engberts 夫人来访。她于1900年5月17日出生于彼得格勒，持有护照号码 17191，该护照由荷兰驻牛庄代理领事于1929年2月20日签发给她，上面未注明国籍，但荷兰驻北平公使馆于1931年10月14日在上面加注，称其丈夫已再次向荷兰女王陛下请愿，请求恢复其荷兰国籍。

Scholl-Engberts 夫人急于再次与丈夫取得联系，并请我从中协助获取他的地址。

在过去几年中，他曾担任一名中国人的保镖，后来在工部局担任巡捕，据我了解，他在后一职位上的表现并不十分令人满意。

然而，我已很久没有听到他的消息，他可能已经离开上海。

尽管如此，如能查询他目前的下落，我将不胜感激。

Scholl-Engberts 夫人居住在马思南路31号，由 de Voyod 夫人转交。

谨致，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
中文秘书。

E. H. Bourne 少校，
特务科主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

P. A.
临时领事 代
（印章：... BRANCH ... 11月17日 ...）

S. &.
（签名）

CONFIDENTIAL.

January 30, 31.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your
letter, No. 93 of January 10, regarding Nicolas
Scholl-Engberts, who resides at No.72 Kungping
Road, and to inform you that there is nothing
in Police records detrimental to his character.

The following information, the
authenticity of which I am unable to guarantee,
has been obtained concerning him:-

Scholl-Engberts was born at Petrograd of respectable
parents and was educated in that city, where his
mother still resides. Being a Netherlands subject
he was exempt from military service in Russia and
did not participate in the Great War, nor has he
been employed in the military or civil service of
any other country. After the Russian revolution
in 1917, he went to Harbin where he worked for about
a year with Kunst & Albers, and afterwards made his
living by selling on commission goods which he peddled
from house to house. He came to Shanghai in the
Spring of 1930, and has since continued to make his
living by peddling as well as giving lessons in the
German language.

机密。

1931年1月30日。

先生，

谨此提及您1月10日关于居住在公平路72号的 Nicolas Scholl-Engberts 的第93号来信，并通知您，警方档案中没有任何损害其品格的记录。

以下是关于他获得的信息，其真实性我无法保证：-

Scholl-Engberts 出生于彼得格勒，父母体面，并在该市接受教育，其母亲仍居住在那里。作为荷兰籍民，他免服俄罗斯的兵役，未参加第一次世界大战，也未在任何其他国家的军队或政府部门任职。1917年俄国革命后，他前往哈尔滨，在 Kunst & Albers 公司工作了约一年，之后靠挨家挨户推销商品赚取佣金维持生计。他于1930年春来到上海，此后继续通过兜售商品以及教授德语课程维持生计。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

It is said that he was once married
to a woman of Netherlands origin whom he divorced
after three years. He is now believed to be on
intimate terms with a Mrs. Serafina Nikolaevna Serduk,
who is employed as a dancing girl in the Victoria
Cabaret, Rue Chu Pao San, French Concession. She
has two children, a daughter 12 years of age, and
a son 9 years of age.

As far as can be ascertained Scholl-Engberts
is not connected with politics in any way.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your Obedient Servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

Consul-General for the Netherlands,

Shanghai.

- 2 -

据说他曾与一名荷兰裔女子结婚，三年后离婚。目前据信他与 Serafina Nikolaevna Serduk 夫人关系亲密，后者在法租界朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）的维多利亚歌舞厅（Victoria Cabaret）担任舞女。她有两个孩子，一个12岁的女儿和一个9岁的儿子。

据查，Scholl-Engberts 与政治没有任何关联。

谨致，

先生，

Date January 27, 1931.
cte 28 - 1 - 31.
Subject (in full) Nicolas Schell-Engberts.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature] D.S.I.

Sir,
With reference to the attached letter of January
10, 1931 from the Consulate General for the Netherlands re
Nicolas Scholl-Engberts residing at No. 62 Kungping Road,
Rec inquiries indicate that his grandfather emigrated from the
Netherlands to Russia and was a well known manufacturer of
linen and underwear in Petrograd. N. Schell-Engberts' father
was a wealthy man and was managing director of the administration
of "Alapaevsk Iron Works" (in Ural East Russia). He was
also a member of the administration of the "Krevlia" Iron
Factory. His mother, Née Fedoreff, is a Russian of good
family and is now living with her daughter in Leningrad.
N. Scholl-Engberts received his education at the
St. Catherine School (German middle school) in Petrograd and
later in a commercial book-keeping school. Being a Netherlands
subject, he did not participate in the Great War and is not
known to have held any Government post. After the revolution
in 1917 N. Schell-Engberts arrived in Harbin where he was
employed with Kunst & Albers for about one year, after which
he was engaged in peddling goods on a small commission basis.
He is reported to have been married to a woman of Netherlands
origin whom he divorced after three years. For the past few
years he has co-habited with Mrs. Serafima Nikolaevna Serduk,
Russian, 32 years of age, dancing partner by profession,
employed at the "Victoria Cabaret," Rue Chu Pao San, French
Concession. She has two children, a daughter, 12 years of age
and a son, 9 years of age. It is not known whether her husband
is dead or not.
Schell-Engberts arrived here in the spring of 1930

先生，
关于所附1931年1月10日荷兰总领事馆关于居住在公平路62号的 Nicolas Scholl-Engberts 的来信，
经查询显示，其祖父从荷兰移民到俄罗斯，是彼得格勒著名的亚麻布和内衣制造商。N. Schell-Engberts 的父亲是一位富人，曾任“阿拉帕耶夫斯克铁工厂”（位于俄罗斯东部乌拉尔地区）的管理董事。他也是“Krevlia”铁工厂管理层的成员。他的母亲，娘家姓 Fedoreff，出身良好的俄罗斯家庭，目前与女儿一起居住在列宁格勒。N. Schell-Engberts 在彼得格勒的圣凯瑟琳学校（德国中学）接受教育，后来在一所商业簿记学校学习。作为荷兰籍民，他没有参加第一次世界大战，也不 Known 担任过任何政府职务。1917年革命后，N. Schell-Engberts 抵达哈尔滨，在 Kunst & Albers 受雇约一年，之后从事小本佣金的货物兜售生意。据报他曾与一名荷兰裔女子结婚，三年后离婚。过去几年里，他与 Serafima Nikolaevna Serduk 夫人同居，后者是俄国人，32岁，职业为舞伴，受雇于法租界朱葆三路的“维多利亚歌舞厅”。她有两个孩子，一个12岁的女儿和一个9岁的儿子。不知其丈夫是否在世。

GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 98

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. REC.
No. S. B. D. 1902.
ate 13 -1- 31.
SHANGHAI, 10th January 1931.

（批：* Sir,
No record
in Sp. Br. Reg.
13/1.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a certain Nicolas
Scholl-Engberts, born at Petrograd, 22 January 1896, of Nether-
lands parents, arrived in Shanghai in spring of last year. He
lost his Netherlands nationality through failing to declare in
time his wish to retain it, but he was often financially sup-
ported by my nationals, both in North China and in Shanghai.

He does not speak his own language, only Russian, German
and some Chinese. English he speaks a little.

It appears that during his stay in Harbin, where he arrived
from Vladivostok, he has always been in straitened circumstances,
and he seems to have associated with bad characters, who brought
him in conflict with the law.

In Shanghai he was also in constant financial difficulties,
and received assistance from the Netherlands Benevolent Society
and other Relief organisations while efforts were made to find
him a job. Under instructions from the Government no financial
support could be given him by this Consulate General.

At present he seems to be occupied in peddling goods on
a small commission basis.

In October of last year Scholl-Engberts petitioned Her
Majesty the Queen of The Netherlands to allow him to regain
his Netherlands nationality through naturalisation, and I am
now directed to make a report concerning his social status and
past activities.

I would be much obliged therefore to know whether his pre-
sence in Shanghai ever gave rise to special observations and
especially whether he is known to entertain revolutionary lean-
ings and should be considered as a dangerous person.

J. L.

To the Commissioner of Police,
Special Branch,
SHANGHAI.

先生：

谨此奉告，有一名为尼古拉斯·肖尔-恩格伯茨（Nicolas Scholl-Engberts）者，于1896年1月22日出生于彼得格勒，父母均为荷兰人，于去年春季抵达上海。他因未及时申报保留国籍之意愿而丧失了荷兰国籍，但他在华北及上海期间，时常得到我国侨民的经济资助。

他不会讲本国语言，仅通俄语、德语及少许中文。英语略懂。

据悉，他在从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达哈尔滨并居留期间，始终处于经济拮据状态，且似乎与不良分子交往，从而卷入法律纠纷。

在上海，他也常陷于财务困境，在为其寻找工作期间，曾接受荷兰慈善协会及其他救济组织的援助。根据政府指示，本总领事馆无法向其提供经济支持。

目前，他似乎从事小本代销货物的营生。

去年十月，肖尔-恩格伯茨向荷兰女王陛下请愿，希望通过归化恢复其荷兰国籍，现奉命就其社会地位及过往活动提交报告。

因此，如蒙告知其在上海居留期间是否曾引起特别关注，尤其是是否已知其怀有革命倾向并应被视为危险人物，本人将不胜感激。

J. L.

致警务处处长，
特别支部，
上海。

- 2 -

I would also like to know whether he has been in foreign
Russian military or government service (customs, posts, etc.).
As far as I know Scholl Engbert's address is now at 62
Kungping Road. Before that he lived at 643 Ave. Joffre, and
26/27 Chaomfoong Road. For a short time he took English lessons
with a Mr.M. I. Scherstnew of 16 Rue Massenet(formerly 27 Route
des Soeurs).

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Consul-General.

- 2 -

此外，本人亦欲知悉他是否曾在外国俄国军队或政府部门（海关、邮政等）服役。据我所知，肖尔-恩格伯茨目前的住址为公平路62号。此前，他居住于霞飞路643号，以及潮丰路26/27号。他曾短暂跟随马森内特路16号（原修女院路27号）的 M. I. Scherstnew 先生学习英语。

谨此致敬，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
总领事
